observations: Three photos show multiple silver 2.5-inch SATA SSDs stacked and bundled with rubber bands.

Each SSD has a white label with printed details: 'Made in TAIWAN', 'Manufactured Date: December 2013', 'Capacity 256GB', 'Model: LCL-256H65', 'F/W DC810E', 'SATA SSD', and regulatory marks (CE, FCC, etc.).
A green circular sticker is on the top of each SSD, with text 'GUARANTEED' visible in photo 0 and photo 2.
The SSDs appear to be identical in design and labeling across all photos.
Photo 1 shows more stacks of SSDs, including some without labels, and a stack of black SSDs or hard drives to the right.
Watermark 'REMEK'S TECHNOLOGY LTD' is visible on all photos.
No visible signs of damage or wear on the SSDs in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show labels with 'Capacity 256GB' and 'SATA SSD'.
No photo shows the SSDs being removed from a system or any system context. The claim cannot be verified from the images.

risks.risk: SSDs may be faulty or not working due to age (manufactured December 2013)
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the SSDs being powered on and recognized by a computer, or a diagnostic test result.

risks.risk: SSDs may have degraded performance or reduced capacity due to wear or bad blocks
risks.proof: A screenshot of a disk utility or diagnostic tool showing full capacity and health status (e.g., S.M.A.R.T. data).

risks.risk: SSDs may be counterfeit or rebranded with misleading labels
risks.proof: A close-up of the PCB or serial number under magnification, or a test showing the actual brand/model via firmware or hardware identification.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the SSDs being tested in a computer, showing they are recognized and functional.
Screenshot of a disk utility or S.M.A.R.T. test showing full capacity and health status.
Close-up of the PCB or serial number to verify authenticity.
response.reason: The SSDs are identifiable by model and capacity, but their functionality, health, and authenticity cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. The age (2013) raises concerns about reliability. Proof of working condition and health is required before pricing.
